# VB-CABLE (third-party, unmodified)

`VBCABLE_Driver_Pack46.zip` is the official VB-CABLE Virtual Audio Device package by
Vincent Burel / VB-Audio Software, copied byte-for-byte from
<https://download.vb-audio.com/Download_CABLE/VBCABLE_Driver_Pack46.zip>.

SHA-256: `bc44e8974191a5a2427d6c979e2dab08dbb09925f3f435dfa2f0ba3e45b6eb90`

It is kept here so WinMusic keeps working offline and even if the website goes away.
WinMusic does not modify it, and does not install it silently: clicking "Install VB-CABLE"
extracts the package and launches VB-Audio's own setup, where you accept their license.

- VB-CABLE is **donationware**. If you like it, support the author: <https://vb-audio.com/Cable/>
- License: see `readme.txt` inside the zip. It is not covered by WinMusic's MIT license.
